messages:
sam: Quick q — thinking about adding a "shape" header to rerank requests so clients can say 'I only want up to N final outputs' vs full candidate scores.
sam: Proposal: X-Rerank-Shape: {"max_results": 10, "return_scores": "compact|full|signed"}
alex: Interesting. What's the main pain? Is it network payload or billing units?
sam: Both. Mobile clients don't need per-candidate scores. Also want to let routing choose cheaper model if only coarse scores needed.
maria: Might be good to decouple billing units (score-units) from payload size. Otherwise consoles show inflated token cost for big candidate lists.
alex: Example header would map to server behavior: if max_results small and return_scores=compact -> compute top-K only, avoid full fanout.
jess: How would this affect fallback and hedging? If we only compute top-3 cheaply and a downstream finds it's low-conf, do we allow re-request with full scores?
sam: Yes — fallback flow: server returns `partial=true` and a suggested expansion token for the client to request a full re-score.
ryan: Telemetry needs flags: shape_requested, partial_returned, fallback_invoked, model_used. Console can then show % partial -> full escalations.
ops: Can we route partial requests to 'fast' models (quantized) and full to higher-precision? That was the idea.
maria: Also we need a consistent scoring envelope: compact should guarantee monotonic order and relative normalization so UI can show deltas.
alex: Another edge: how do we bill customers? Two options: a) bill based on work done (fanout*cost-per-score) b) bill at published units based on request shape. Option a seems fair but harder to explain.
sam: agree, prefer a) but console UX must show estimated vs actual cost and an ops knob to cap expansion cost.
jess: UX for rollouts: start with canary where only internal apps honor the header. Then expose in beta with telemetry on and rollout guide.
dev-bot: deploy:rerank-shape-gate -> canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%
ryan: For metrics: add histograms for result_count, compute_time_per_candidate, model_variant, and a flag for partial_to_full latency.
ops: Also, include quota enforcement: hard cap on max_results per tenant, fallback to truncation + warning headers.
maria: On API contract: examples in spec. Suggest adding proto snippet in spec:

```
message RerankShape {
  int32 max_results = 1;
  enum ScoreMode { COMPACT = 0; FULL = 1; SIGNED = 2; }
  ScoreMode return_scores = 2;
}
```

alex: SGTM. Let's add an explicit 'partial_token' field server can return so clients can auto-escalate.
sam: Cool. Next steps: I'll PR spec, add telemetry counters, and make console tiles for partial->full rate and cost delta. Can we get an eng-owner for rollout docs?
jess: I'll own rollout docs and canary playbook.
alex: I'll pick up server-side quota enforcement and routing mapping.
ryan: I'll wire telemetry + dashboards.
ops: I'll draft quota defaults and warning header text.
sam: Thanks all. Filing follow-ups: assigned in ticket INF-6243. Ping me if anyone needs early access.
dev-bot: ticket created: INF-6243
sam: noted :thumbsup:
